messages.subject: Shiny apps_issue with decimal point/comma in numericInput()
parts:
Hi,

When I do runApp() and enter numbers  with decimal point in numericinput() boxes, it is OK!
But when I open the app in Firefox ('Open in Browser'), it suddenly requires that I enter numbers with decimal comma and if I do not so, it will not recognize the numbers anymore...I got the same problem whether I do runApp() on my local machine or I do deployApp() and I run it in my internet browser from the shinyapps.io website.

Here is an easy example:I actually directly used your "isolate example" by Winston Chang on http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/. In the ui.R, I just changed the sliderInput() to numericInput() and add step=0.01 (see attached files in case).

Thanks for your reply
